title: Chapter 71
content:
Consciousness crept back slowly, but lifting his heavy eyelids felt like hauling lead.

A biting chill clung to his bare skin, accompanied by a foul, pungent stench of preservation chemicals and iron. Muffled voices drifted over the quiet hum of a ventilation fan.

[He’s covered in scars... Are you sure you’re fine with that?]

[Yes. I know it’s an unusual request, but I’d appreciate your finest work today.]

[Well, this is my first time working on a human subject... I can’t guarantee perfection.]

[I’ll pay whatever price you name. Ah—and when you’re finished, please excise the eyes and hand them over to me.]

The deep, velvety baritone belonged unmistakably to Kang Il-hyun.

Jakyeong forced his eyes open. The blurred haze gradually resolved into focus. He shifted his neck, catching sight of Il-hyun’s broad back standing beside a frail, white-haired stranger in an apron.

Jakyeong tried to move his limbs, but heavy leather restraints pinned his wrists and ankles securely to the steel corners of an examination table. A thick strip of duct tape sealed his lips, stifling any attempt to speak.

Scanning the perimeter, an icy dread seized the base of his skull.

Lining the shelves and walls in every direction were glassy-eyed, mounted specimens: wild boars, stags, falcons, rabbits, and various forest game frozen in lifelike postures. Looking down, he realized he was stripped to nothing but his briefs, laid bare across a cold stainless-steel slab.

Turning around, Il-hyun caught sight of the conscious boy and offered a bright, radiant smile.

"Look who’s finally awake, darling."

The smile was dazzling, yet the dark pupils beneath were colder than a winter grave. Jakyeong thrashed against the bindings, desperate to shout, but only muffled, strangled grunts broke past the adhesive.

The white-haired taxidermist stepped forward, chuckling softly as he examined Jakyeong’s face with unsettling curiosity.

"Ah, now I understand why you insisted on keeping the eyes intact. Such a breathtaking, rare color."

Jakyeong hauled on the leather straps with every ounce of his strength, slamming the back of his head against the steel slab in frantic protest.

Il-hyun strode over, resting a gentle hand against his forehead to smooth back his sweat-damp fringe.

"Shh... Be a good boy. It will all be over shortly."

The tender inflection sent violent shivers down Jakyeong’s spine. The mounted animals lining the walls, the grotesque conversation... the horrifying reality finally clicked into place. This unhinged monster actually intends to stuff me and mount me in his bedroom—and keep my eyeballs in a jar on his nightstand.

Muffled shrieks tore against the tape as Jakyeong thrashed with renewed frenzy.

"Seems the young man has plenty to say to you," the taxidermist remarked.

Il-hyun placed a fresh cigarette between his lips, flicking a lighter. "Pay him no mind. Every word that slips past his lips is a lie anyway."

Jakyeong continued to grunt and heave against the tape, his eyes blazing with panicked fury.

With a detached, indifferent expression, Il-hyun finally reached down and ripped the adhesive away in one sharp jerk.

The moment his mouth was free, Jakyeong unleashed a furious roar:

"You psychotic, son of a—"

Slap.

A fresh strip of tape sealed over his mouth before the curse could even finish.

Jakyeong glared murderously through clenched teeth, but Il-hyun merely leaned against the slab, exhaling a thick plume of gray smoke into the air.

"Shall I begin the preparation?" the old man asked, picking up a tray of surgical tools.

Panic seized Jakyeong. With his limbs immobilized, he began rhythmically slamming the back of his skull against the metal table once more. Il-hyun slid a large palm beneath his head, cushioning the impact.

Jakyeong froze, locking eyes with the predator hovering above him.

Il-hyun dropped his cigarette to the floor, extinguishing the ember beneath the sole of his oxford shoe before fixing an unblinking gaze onto Jakyeong's face.

"This is your absolute last chance."

"..."

"Think carefully about what words I want to hear from you right now."

Slowly, Il-hyun peeled the edge of the tape back once more. Jakyeong clamped his mouth shut, his chest heaving for air.

"Nothing to say?"

The moment Il-hyun raised the tape to seal him again, Jakyeong blurted out the first desperate concession he could muster:

"I... I was wrong! I'm sorry! I swear I won't do it again!"

His mind raced frantically, trying to deduce what kind of confession would pacify the lunatic, but nothing made sense. As the adhesive hovered inches from his lips, Jakyeong surrendered all pride and screamed:

"I like you, President Kang!"

Il-hyun’s dark brow arched. "Are you being sincere?"

Jakyeong swallowed hard. Pride, dignity, professional reputation—none of it mattered compared to keeping his pulse beating.

"Yes! I really like you! Running away was a stupid mistake! I spent every single day agonizing over whether I should come back to you!"

"Is that so? I distinctly recall you complaining about sleeping with me."

Jakyeong shook his head frantically. "No! I loved it! I've never experienced such sublime, incredible sex in my entire life! Please, believe me!"

He spewed whatever shameless flattery he could invent, babbling that he had spent the last year thinking about Il-hyun day and night.

Gradually, the murderous rigidity in Il-hyun's expression began to thaw. Did it actually work?

Il-hyun glanced toward the taxidermist prepping tools on the counter, giving a subtle tilt of his chin toward the exit. Understanding the cue, the old man slipped quietly out the door, latching it from the outside.

Left alone in the workshop, Il-hyun slowly swept his gaze from Jakyeong's face down to his bare toes. His large palm grazed over the lean muscles of Jakyeong's abdomen before tracing upward, lingering over his chest.

The moment fingertips brushed over his nipple, Jakyeong instinctively tensed.

Il-hyun rolled the sensitive bud between his thumb and forefinger, applying a sharp, teasing pinch that made Jakyeong curl his toes and bite down hard on his lower lip.

Releasing the flesh, Il-hyun stepped onto the table frame, straddling Jakyeong’s chest.

He unbuckled his leather belt and lowered his zipper, freeing his heavy, fully engorged shaft.

"Prove it."

Il-hyun caught a fistful of dark hair, wrenching Jakyeong's head forward. He stroked the broad, weeping head of his cock against the boy's parted lips, whispering in a low, dangerous purr:

"Prove how much you missed it."

Jakyeong parted his lips. The thick erection pushed past his teeth. He opened his jaw as wide as possible, but swallowing the full girth was an anatomical impossibility.

Il-hyun’s free hand gently caressed the hollow of Jakyeong's throat.

"Relax your neck. That's the only way it goes all the way in."

Without a shred of tenderness, Il-hyun thrust his hips forward, bottoming out into the tight canal.

The intrusion choked the breath from Jakyeong's lungs. He arched off the steel in agony, but Il-hyun pinned his head down, pumping his hips in a brutal, uncompromising rhythm.

Strangled, wet gasps tore from Jakyeong's throat as hot tears pricked the corners of his eyes from the violent gag reflex.

Struggling against the leather cuffs, Jakyeong forced his blurred gaze upward.

Towering over him, Il-hyun’s jaw was clenched tight, his brow furrowed in a dark, furious scowl. He didn't look like a man indulging in pleasure—he looked like a man drowning in raw, suffocating wrath.

Deprived of oxygen, tears spilled over Jakyeong's eyelashes, tracking down his flushed temples.

Suddenly, Il-hyun withdrew entirely.

Jakyeong collapsed back onto the metal slab, coughing violently as saliva and bile trailed from the corner of his lips in heavy dry heaves.

"Pathetic."

Spitting out the single word with cold disdain, Il-hyun adjusted his trousers, buckled his belt, and stepped down from the examination table.

As if the violence had never occurred, he leaned over to gently brush the damp hair from Jakyeong’s brow, carefully dabbed the saliva from his chin with a handkerchief, and placed a soft, lingering kiss on the bridge of his nose.

Did his temper pass?

Before the thought could settle, the workshop door swung open, and the white-haired taxidermist stepped back inside.

"Everything is prepared," Il-hyun said smoothly. "You may begin."

Jakyeong’s eyes blew wide in sheer terror.

Without a heartbeat of hesitation, Il-hyun slapped the heavy duct tape back over Jakyeong’s lips. As Jakyeong screamed muffled curses against the seal, Il-hyun cradled his cheek, offering a look of tender, theatrical pity.

"You should have known better than to test my patience while I was still being sweet to you."

The old taxidermist stepped to the bedside, handing a pre-loaded glass syringe across to Il-hyun.

Il-hyun clamped his fingers around Jakyeong’s jaw, positioning the needle over his jugular. A chilling, demonic smirk spread across his handsome face.

"Don't be afraid, darling. I'll make sure you become the most beautiful specimen in the entire world."

The needle pierced the vein.

A heavy, burning numbness flooded his bloodstream. Jakyeong fought with everything he had to keep his eyes open, but his nervous system shut down rapidly under the heavy paralytic. Tears of pure, helpless terror slipped past his lashes, soaking into his hairline.

Fuck... Not like this. I refuse to die like this...

The chilling image of Kang Il-hyun’s smiling face was the last thing his fading senses registered before the darkness swallowed him whole.
Reviewing the glossy surveillance prints spread across his mahogany desk, Chairman Kang’s expression hardened into stone.

A few nights ago, Choi Man-sik—a key figure in the domestic narcotics trade—had been found dead inside his private club. The man had long handled money laundering and various off-the-books wet work for Chairman Kang’s faction, only to be butchered overnight.

More troubling was the security footage: the lone assassin captured leaving the VIP corridor bore an uncanny physical resemblance to Lee Ja-kyeong.

Dismissing it as mere coincidence was impossible. To make matters worse, Kang Il-hyun had formally notified the executive board earlier that morning that he would be conducting all corporate duties remotely from his private estate due to personal reasons.

Whatever game his son was playing, it was spinning out of control.

"Find out who has entered or left President Kang's estate over the past forty-eight hours," Chairman Kang ordered.

Secretary Kim hesitated, wearing a conflicted grimace. "It will take considerable time, sir. As you know, the surrounding terrain is completely flat and cleared of cover. Establishing a static surveillance perimeter without being spotted is nearly impossible."

Chairman Kang struck a match, lighting a fresh cigar.

Il-hyun had deliberately leveled the surrounding hills and treeline for this very purpose—turning the estate into an open fortress where any amateur spy would be exposed immediately. Sending a covert detail risked escalating into an outright firefight.

After a moment's calculation, Chairman Kang dialed the intercom, summoning Kang Seok-joo to the study.

Moments later, the youngest son stepped inside, nervously reading the room. It was exceptionally rare for his father to summon him directly to the private study.

"Did you... need something, Father?"

"Take a trip down to your second brother's estate this afternoon."

Seok-joo’s eyes went wide. Second brother? Kang Il-hyun? The prospect of visiting that monster's domain sent an immediate chill down his spine.

"Word is his health has taken a turn," Chairman Kang said smoothly, sliding a wooden box across the desk. "Deliver this premium restorative medicine to him."

"Me... sir?"

When Seok-joo hesitated, Chairman Kang’s eyes narrowed into a terrifying glare.

"Useless brat. He's your own brother—what are you trembling for?"

Stung by the open contempt, Seok-joo lowered his head, reluctantly accepting the assignment.

As he turned to leave, his gaze snagged on a stray photograph resting near Secretary Kim's elbow.

The edge of the glossy print was unmistakably clear.

It was Jang Yi-an.

Why does Father have a surveillance photo of Yi-an on his desk?

Before he could process the question, Secretary Kim ushered him out the double doors, latching the study behind him.

Fucking unbelievable, Seok-joo cursed internally, clutching the medicine box. Why is everyone in this family so desperate to make my life hell?

Curiosity getting the better of him, he pressed his ear against the heavy wood paneling, but the soundproofing was impenetrable, leaving him with nothing but dead silence.
